detail.title: Hysteresis vs. Memory in Autocatalytic Reaction Networks
detail.summary: Revised analysis incorporating non-equilibrium feedback, stoichiometric submatrices, and freezing memory dynamics to distinguish state-dependent memory from simple transient persistence.
detail.reason: Revising notebook-autocatalytic-memory-1 with newly acquired evidence on memory control and stoichiometric conditions.
